summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _Reader and _ContextWrapper, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file, imports); tests/test_progress.py (22 new tests before the script-entry block); docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased/Added bullet linking PR 1759). Not verified: tests, black, isort, flake8, and mypy were not run. Open risks: mypy may flag wrap_file's return or the TextIOWrapper(reader) argument, which would need a suppression the spec does not sanction; long lines depend on black leaving type-ignore lines alone; the io.open monkeypatch test is the riskiest. Choices made where the spec was silent: mode returns "rb" and name falls back to getattr(handle, "name", ""); the context wrapper enters and exits the returned file object; a failed enter stops the display; write raises io.UnsupportedOperation("write"). No commits were made.
